moonshot.paragraph: I lead engineering at Moonshot. We make an AI pendant, and it's shipping to customers now.

auros.paragraph: Auros is a personalized Linux you install with a double click. It's for people who aren't technical, or who just need a kiosk.

cadybara.paragraph: Cadybara turns a description of a part into CAD. It's backed by Founders Inc, and I built it.

mosscross.paragraph: MossCross is backed by Founders Inc. We clean moss off Pacific Northwest roofs with drones and an autopilot I wrote. Everyone else does it by hand and makes too much to bother automating.

rocket.paragraph: It's 3D-printed and designed to land itself by tilting its own engine. I wrote a defense-grade 6-DOF simulator for it with live CFD and FEA that emulates its electronics and flight code, and ran it 14,030 times.

research.paragraph: At UW I design autonomous drones with NOAA that run below, on and above the water, and do the data analysis that keeps them alive. At Northwestern I build multiscale physics simulations of metal 3D printing.

vaidra.paragraph: I built Vaidra's speech pipeline in 7 languages for classrooms with one speaker and no screens. It reached 9,000+ students across 200+ schools.

vex.paragraph: I've made Worlds 5 times in 8 seasons as captain and engineering lead. I started in 4th grade.

battlebots.paragraph: Bravado is aiming for BattleBots in 2028. Solo, as Mantis Combat Robotics, I designed and built 1, 3, 5 and 25 lb bots.

frc.paragraph: On Team 1899 I led 17 students across 3 subteams building a t-shirt cannon. I also built mechanisms for our robot, which qualified for the 2024 World Championship.

runway.paragraph: Runway AI coaches pageant contestants with AI. It started as CoachT, for taekwondo studios, and I co-founded it and ran marketing.
